name: @agentpair/protocol
description: AgentPair v0 protocol — crypto, envelopes, SPAKE2 pairing

scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm/spake2-pake && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../pkg --out-name spake2_pake
scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp -R wasm/pkg dist/wasm/ && rm -f dist/wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.verify-fixtures: pnpm run generate-fixtures && git diff --exit-code -- fixtures/
